function.name: concert_finder
function.description: Locate upcoming concerts based on music genre in specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The user wants to find upcoming concerts in the next month in California San Francisco and New York for rock and jazz. We need to call the function concert_finder twice? Actually we need to find concerts in both cities and for both genres. The function takes location, music_genre, time_period. We can call it twice: one for San Francisco, one for New York. But we also need to specify music_genre. The user wants both rock and jazz. We could call twice per city? Or maybe we can combine? The function expects a single music_genre string. So we might need to call it twice per city: once for rock, once for jazz. That would be four calls. But maybe we can pass "rock,jazz" as a comma-separated string? The function spec says music_genre: string. It doesn't say multiple allowed. So likely we need separate calls.

We should call concert_finder with location "San Francisco, CA", music_genre "Rock", time_period 30. Then again with location "San Francisco, CA", music_genre "Jazz". Then same for New York, NY.
